# SPD-026 — PreAgentTest fails whenever member new draws the name Kestrel

## Brief
tests/test_hooks.py PreAgentTest.test_lineage_persona_and_name_must_match_the_row plans one member under a random pool name, then expects SPUD-001/Kestrel (01, scout) to be denied as 'no planned member'. When the draw picks Kestrel, that description is the planned row itself and the spawn is allowed, so the whole suite fails about once in 60 runs with no code change. That can make a merge verification look red for nothing, or teach Spud to rerun red suites. The fix is to plan the row under a fixed name other than Kestrel (name='Yukon').

Evidence: bin/spud draw_name picks ORDER BY random() LIMIT 1 over the active naming.pool (60 names in spud.config.json) minus the ticket's names; the test's third description is the literal SPUD-001/Kestrel (01, scout). Hit twice on 2026-09-13 on branch worktree-spd-018-stop-hook-sessions, a test SPD-018's diff does not touch: the whole suite on main plus SPD-018 in scratch ('AssertionError: Tuples differ: (0, allow) != (0, deny) : SPUD-001/Kestrel (01, scout)'), then PreAgentTest alone in the worktree (same assertion). PreAgentTest alone passed 16/16 in the merged copy, and the worktree's three whole-suite runs passed.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on sonnet, below the persona's opus tier (`--tier-reason`): the fix is a fixed name in one test plus a grep audit of the tests for the same collision, which is mechanical work. No Fable (Eric, 2026-09-13); no children and no probe. Tests are code, so the work goes on a worktree branch. Spud reads the diff and reruns the suite at return.
